records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ines,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Ventures
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first project created on day 2, welcome call held as scheduled (calendar:41988f00), Team plan, active. But no invites sent despite two prompts (email:120cea56, email:199ab2d5), no customer-initiated contact, and 5 days of silence since the call with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Next step after your Harbor Ventures project
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week -- good to get the lay of the land on how Harbor Ventures runs projects.

You've already got a first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. The usual next step is bringing the rest of the team in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your team set up alongside you.

Best,
Nadia
